_comment: Template for content/<slug>/gate/notes.json — AUTHORITATIVE scene intent for the vlm_gate (rule G2: write BEFORE the first keyframe render). One entry per scene id (hook, s0..sN). State what is BY DESIGN: fast-beat timing, end-states, contrast choices, deliberate absences. The gate flags against these notes; stale/missing notes caused 5 false fails on #0003 (L-070). Keep each note 2-6 sentences, concrete.

notes.hook: The premise visual is on screen at t=0 (rule S2): <describe>. <What is by design: e.g. the kinetic title IS the caption here — no pill (rule C1).>
notes.s0: <Scene intent. E.g.: FAST STAMP BEATS (~1s each) — a keyframe shows ONLY the beat active at its timestamp; earlier beats are gone in later frames BY DESIGN (L-065).>
notes.s1: <E.g.: diagram scene on a dark stage panel. The <subject> is <lit/dark> BY DESIGN (rule C2: opposite value of ground). Links draw on one by one — early frames legitimately show fewer; gate the end-state (rule G4).>
notes.s9: <E.g.: the loop-out mirrors the hook composition; <element> fading in during the tilt is by design.>
